chapter.heading: Israel Will Reap the Whirlwind
chapter.v:
Put the
ram’s horn to your lips!An eagle looms over the house of the LORD,because the people have transgressed My covenantand rebelled against My law.

Israel cries
out to Me,“O our God, we know You!”

But Israel
has rejected good;an enemy will pursue him.

They set
up kings, but not by Me.They make princes, but without My approval.With their silver and gold they make themselves idols,to their own destruction.

He has
rejected your calf, O Samaria.My anger burns against them.How long will they beincapable of innocence?

For this
thing is from Israel—a craftsman made it, and it is not God.It will be broken to pieces,that calf of Samaria.

For they
sow the wind,and they shall reap the whirlwind.There is no standing grain;what sprouts fails to yield flour.Even if it should produce,the foreigners would swallow it up.

Israel is
swallowed up!Now they are among the nationslike a worthless vessel.

For they
have gone up to Assyrialike a wild donkey on its own.Ephraim has hired lovers.

Though they
hire allies among the nations,I will now round them up,and they will begin to diminishunder the oppression of the king of princes.

Though Ephraim
multiplied the altars for sin,they became his altars for sinning.

Though I
wrote for them the great things of My law,they regarded them as something strange.

Though they
offer sacrifices as gifts to Me,and though they eat the meat,the LORD does not accept them.Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins:They will return to Egypt.

Israel has
forgotten his Maker and built palaces;Judah has multiplied its fortified cities.But I will send fire upon their cities,and it will consume their citadels.
